title: Paddle out into the Northern Marine Reserve
description: Fornells bay is sheltered from the open sea and sits inside the northern marine reserve: you paddle out from the village to coves and caves reachable only from the water, stopping to snorkel in clear water. No engine, no noise, about three hours. Book ahead; trips run when the sea allows.
imageAlt: A street in Fornells running down to the water between whitewashed houses
